steps.en: Officer can tick several notices in the list
steps.id: Officer bisa mencentang beberapa notice di daftar
steps.why_en: Selecting exists, but only for other bulk functions.
steps.why_id: Pemilihan ada, tapi hanya untuk fungsi bulk lain.

steps.en: Officer picks enable or disable for the selection
steps.id: Officer memilih aktifkan atau nonaktifkan untuk pilihan
steps.why_en: The bulk menu has no enable or disable payment choice.
steps.why_id: Menu bulk tidak punya pilihan aktifkan atau nonaktifkan pembayaran.

steps.en: One decision is applied to all selected notices
steps.id: Satu keputusan diterapkan ke semua notice terpilih
steps.why_en: Batch saving exists, but only when another system calls it, not from officer selection.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan batch ada, tapi hanya saat sistem lain memanggil, bukan dari pilihan officer.
